headline: AADE: 12,000 taxpayers under the microscope – who will receive a notice and what they must do within 15 days
summary: The Independent Authority for Public Revenue (AADE) is proceeding with extensive tax audits of 12,000 taxpayers immediately after tax return submissions were completed.
why: AADE is Greece's tax and customs authority, and its audit activity affects tax compliance and public revenue collection.
